scores.rationale: The candidate fundamentally diverged from the issue specification in its own Definition of Done (.lore/dod.md) and implementation. Instead of implementing the `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` message types (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`), it invented `list_sessions` and `session_list` (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`). Worse, it explicitly violated a core requirement and acceptance criterion of the ticket: when a store lacks `listFor`, the candidate returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) instead of returning an `error` frame with the new `UNSUPPORTED` error code. It also appears to have missed the required `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md` updates, startup warnings when `history` is enabled without `resume`, and downgraded `specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md` status from `Shipped` to `In Progress`.
